standing_rule_adopted: Any truncation orders by a declared evidence property first. sorted() may only break ties afterwards. Three separate defects in this project were lexicographic accident acting as a decision rule.

projection.why: Frozen per-case states are in owner-controlled storage. States were synthesised to match the published aggregates: 79 records, 152 direct occurrences with mean 1.92, 19 records carrying at least 3, and 213 supported dimension occurrences with mean 2.70.
projection.headline: The six concepts take secondary from roughly half the cases to nearly all of them, and roughly double the mean secondary count.
projection.why_mean_main_is_below_1.92: Not an error. Records carrying more than three direct words contribute exactly 3 to main and route the remainder to secondary, so mean main is necessarily below the 1.92 mean direct-evidence count. The two numbers measure different things.
simulation_limits: The direct-count distribution is constructed to satisfy mean 1.92 and the 19-of-79 constraint, but its exact shape is unknown.
Dimension activation is assigned at random with a 70 percent SUPPORTED split, which is an assumption, not a measurement.
These figures indicate direction and rough magnitude. They are not the audit.

still_blocked.real_evaluation: Needs the 474 per-case returns in owner-controlled storage.
